interval_contract.purpose: The delivery contract that reserves this recording's sealed held-out panel (plus its exclusion buffer) and the healthy evaluation intervals. Selection may only rank case spans that lie inside one of its intervals.development_windows.windows_s; those windows are re-derived and re-validated at runtime, not trusted as shipped.

units.depth_shift_um_material: micrometres (inclusive lower bound, >=; |median depth of the failing windows - median depth of the reference windows|, from spike_positions.npy)
units.amplitude_drop_frac_material: fraction of the reference median (inclusive lower bound, >=; (reference median amplitude - failing median amplitude) / reference median amplitude, in sorter-native amplitude units)
units.min_events_per_window_for_shift: assigned events per window (count; below this the shift is reported but its verdict is withheld as underpowered)
units.voltage_saturation_uv: microvolts (absolute; the rescue conditioning's samplewise bilateral blanking threshold, so a sample at or beyond it was clipped by that stage)
units.voltage_saturated_frac_material: fraction of read samples (inclusive lower bound, >=; at or beyond voltage_saturation_uv across the frozen channels of this case's windows)

evidence.note: Proposed triage constants for ONE comparison each, frozen before any evidence is read, exactly as the selection constants are. They are not calibrated biological thresholds and no verdict they produce is a causal claim.

units.windows_per_case: windows (count); also the control's 'at least four consecutive valid windows'
units.max_span_s: seconds (inclusive upper bound, <=; first window start_s to last window end_s)
units.control_max_range_pp: percentage points (inclusive upper bound, <=; max - min)

provenance.num_samples_source: NOT independently available: traces_cached_seg0.raw has been deleted from disk. duration_s and selected_start_sample are estimated from this sort's own curated spike_times.npy extent (max sample 314204877, matching rescue's max sample exactly), not from an authoritative recording manifest. inventory's recording-metadata check marks duration_validated=false for this sort.
